title: Are There Coral Reefs in Madeira?
description: No. The sea cools to about 18 °C in late winter, the limit for reef corals, and the island drops steeply. Rocky reefs, seaweed, urchins and fish grow instead.
heroAlt: Underwater view of a volcanic rocky reef with seaweed, urchins and a shoal of fish

images.prompt: Underwater photo over a volcanic rocky reef at about five metres off Madeira's south coast. Dark boulders partly covered in brown lobed seaweed and pink crusts of coralline algae, a few black sea urchins in the gaps, a shoal of silver salema passing above and a green ornate wrasse in the foreground. Deep blue water, soft sunlight rays from above, true colours, no divers, no text.
